description: Controls nested virtualization, namely 'svm' for AMD CPUs and 'vmx' for Intel CPUs. Live migration still only works if it's the same flag on both sides. Use a CPU model similar to the host, with the same vendor, not x86-64-vX!
name: nested-virt

description: Activate AES instruction set for HW acceleration.
name: aes

description: Improves Spectre mitigation performance with AMD CPUs, best used with 'virt-ssbd'.
name: amd-ssbd

description: Allows improved Spectre mitigation with AMD CPUs.
name: ibpb

description: Required to let the guest OS know if MDS is mitigated correctly.
name: md-clear

description: Meltdown fix cost reduction on Westmere, Sandy-, and IvyBridge Intel CPUs.
name: pcid

description: Allow guest OS to use 1GB size pages, if host HW supports it.
name: pdpe1gb

description: Allows improved Spectre mitigation with Intel CPUs.
name: spec-ctrl

description: Protection for 'Speculative Store Bypass' for Intel models.
name: ssbd

description: Basis for 'Speculative Store Bypass' protection for AMD models.
name: virt-ssbd

description: Notifies guest OS that host is not vulnerable for Spectre on AMD CPUs.
name: amd-no-ssb

description: Improve performance for nested virtualization. Only supported on Intel CPUs.
name: hv-evmcs

description: Improve performance in overcommitted Windows guests. May lead to guest bluescreens on old CPUs.
name: hv-tlbflush
